subject: Post-call: Deployment mode & cost modeling follow-up (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservco.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@finservco.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap - deployment options

Thanks for the call earlier, Aditya — that was helpful. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- Traffic profile: our pilot will start with ~20 req/s peak, expected to grow to 80 req/s over 6 months. Avg context length ~800 tokens.
- Data sensitivity: customer PII will be present; we need SOC2 + option for VPC or on-prem.
- Cost constraints: procurement prefers predictable monthly commits if the delta vs pay-as-you-go is >20%.

Main ask: could you share an apples-to-apples cost comparison (hosted per-token vs Dedicated reserved commit) and an estimate for Private (VPC) uplift? Also confirm SLA/uptime and where KMS would live.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of ML Platforms, FinServCo

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap - deployment options

Alex — thanks for the quick summary and for sharing the traffic and security constraints. High level recap + next steps below.

Recap from our call:
- Pilot profile: 20 req/s -> 80 req/s over 6 months; avg 800 token context.
- Security: SOC2 required; leaning toward VPC/private deployment for production due to PII.
- Pricing preference: procurement favors predictable monthly reserved commits if cost delta >20%.

What I'm attaching: a first-pass cost model (FinServCo_CostModel_Hosted-vs-Dedicated-v1.xlsx) that compares:
- Hosted API: per-token pricing (no infra commit), with estimated monthly spend based on your traffic profile;
- Dedicated: reserved GPU capacity (monthly/annual commit) with throughput-based cost;
- Private (VPC): Dedicated + networking/KMS uplift and optional on-prem quote.

Notes on the model (key assumptions):
- We modeled token throughput assuming 1.2 tokens/response token for prompt overhead and 0.3 tokens/response for system tokens.
- Dedicated commit pricing assumes an M60-equivalent reserved pool sized to meet the 80 req/s target with 99th-percentile latency SLOs.
- Hosted per-token includes a small SLA premium for enterprise tenants and built-in autoscaling.

Answers to your specific asks: 
- SLA: Hosted API (enterprise) 99.9% uptime; Dedicated (reserved) SLA options up to 99.95% depending on commitment. Private (VPC) SLAs provided for control plane; infra SLA depends on hosting (cloud partner) and contract.
- KMS: For VPC we integrate with customer KMS (Cloud KMS / HSM) and can support key material residency in your account.

Proposed next steps: 
1) I'll follow up with a short summary email for procurement that lays out the delta numbers and recommended option. (By EOD today)
2) Internal: Marissa will run a sensitivity analysis around commit size vs unit cost.
3) Schedule a short working session with your procurement + security to walk the model and the SOC2 artifacts.

Can you confirm an internal procurement time window (e.g., do you have a quarter-bound decision deadline)? Also, any other stakeholders to loop in?

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Attachment: FinServCo_CostModel_Hosted-vs-Dedicated-v1.xlsx
From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@finservco.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservco.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 08:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap - deployment options

Aditya — thanks for the model. A few immediate clarifications from procurement/security: 

1) For Dedicated reserved commits, procurement wants an example commit cadence (monthly vs annual) and the flexibility to scale down after Q1 with penalty terms. Can you include example tier sizes?
2) For Private/VPC please call out additional operational costs (network egress, dedicated support) as a line item.
3) SOC2: can you send the cert or whitepaper and a short list of the artifacts we'd need for our audit?

Decision timing: we are aiming to decide on a pilot vendor by 2026-03-31 to start procurement in April.

Thanks — Priya
Principal Procurement Manager, FinServCo
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@finservco.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap - deployment options

Thanks Priya — quick answers inline and next steps.

1) Commit cadence and tier examples:
- Monthly reserved: smaller upfront (month-to-month) with 6% uplift vs annual; good if you need flexibility.
- Annual reserved: 12-month commit with deeper discounts (15–30% vs hosted per-token depending on size).
- Example tiers (sized for your 80 req/s target): Small (baseline) = 2 reserved nodes ~ handles 25–30 req/s; Medium = 4 nodes ~ handles 60 req/s; Large = 6 nodes ~ handles 100+ req/s. We'll run a sensitivity sheet — Marissa will drop scenarios for 3/5/10% growth.

2) Private/VPC line items to expect (we'll include these as separate rows in the updated model):
- Network egress estimates (cloud dependent).
- Dedicated support and onboarding fee (one-time).
- KMS integration/ops uplift (one-time + monthly).
- Optional on-prem HVAC and rack estimates if you go air-gapped.

3) SOC2: attaching the SOC2 summary + we can provide the cert under NDA. Typical artifacts customers ask for: system description, control matrices, incident response evidence, and encryption/KMS configurations.

Next steps (concrete):
- Marissa to send updated cost model with commit cadence + line item breakdown (EOD Thu 3/5).
- I'll prepare a procurement-friendly one-pager that compares hosted vs dedicated vs private (cost delta and recommended option) — will share before EOD Thu.
- Schedule a 45-minute working session next week to walk procurement + security — propose Thu 3/11 10am PT. Please confirm availability.

Link: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5221/D-2026-0421

Best,
Aditya
